bu mos smras pa/ sus gzhung brtsad71pas bdag thub par nus pa ri de la stsal bar gsol/ de nas rgyal pos de thos nas 'dis5ba'adi lta bu'i tshig smras pa las na/ bu mo 'di ni ngas gzhung smra ba gang gis 'di thub pa de 'ba' zhig la sbyin par bya'i byad gzugs bzang ba la yang mi sbyin/ rigs mtho ba la yang mi sbyin / dbang phyug dang ldan pa la yang mi sbyin no zhes zer ro/ /de nas de'i sgra de kun kutso)grags nas/ de thos ma thag tu phyogs kun nas gzhung smra ba rnams lhagasalgepa las bu mo des thams cad tshar bcad do/ /de nas de'i tshe lho phyogs na gzhung smra ba ri'u me zhes bya ba bstanamasabacos thams cad la 'jigs pa med pa gtsug lag che ba/ gtsug lag la 'byam59)pa gzugs bzang zhing blta khon sdug la mdzes pa/ kha dog shin tu rgyas pa dang ldan pa zhig gnas pa des yul tak+ṣa shrī /nyala'i rgyal po pad ma'i snying po'i sras mos gzhung smra 12ba thams cad tshar bcad la de'i yab kyis kyang de lta bur dam bcas so zhes thos so/ /de thos ma thag tu de ya mtshan du gyur te/ bdag der song la de ci shes pa blta'o snyam mo / /de nas de 'khor lnga brgya dang chas te/ grong dang / grong khyer dang /grong rdal dang / nags khrod kyi grong dang / yul po che rnams su rgyu zhing gzhung smra ba rnams kyang tshar gcod par byed pa las mthar gyis yul tak+ṣa shrī nyanyalar phyin nas des rgyal po pad ma'i snying po can gyi thad du song nas smras pa/ bdag gis thos na lha lha'i sras mos gzhung smra ba thams cad tshar bcad /gces gda' na/bdag7gis kyang mkhan po las bstan bcos bslabs pa dag mchis pas bdag kyang de dang bka' mchid bgyi bar 'tshal lo/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyod ji ltar dga' ba bzhin du bya'o zhes smras nas/ rgyal pomo des gzhung smra ba'i 'khor 73—101

bsags ①te so so'i gzhung btsugs nas bu mo de yol ba'i nang du bzhag ste/bu mo des gzhung smra ba'i ri'u zhes bya ba gzugs bzang zhing blta ②na sdug la/mdzes pa ②kha dog rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa mthong nas de mthong ma thag tu 'dod chags kyi mdas phog ste/ des bsams pa/ bdag gis khyim thab 'di 'dra ba ga las kyang mi rnyed kyisaraba'adi kho na bdag gi khyim thab tu bya dgos kyi gzhan ⑥ni mi 'dod do snyam du bsams nas/ des ci nas gzhung ⑦smra ba des bdag thub par 'gyur ba de ltar byas so/ /de nas rgyal pos bsams pa/bdag gis dam bcas pa la gzhung smra ba gang gis 'di thub par 'gyur ba de la bdag gis 'di sbyin par bya'i(she/ bdag gis 'di byad gzugs bzang ba la yang mi sbyin/ rigs mtho ba la yang mi sbyin dbang phyug dang ldan pa la yang mi sbyin no zhes dam bcas pa las/ 'dis 'di thub par gyur la 'di yang gzugs bzang zhing bltasan sdug la mdzes te/ bdag gis 'di las lhag pa gud nas gzhung smra ba ches khyad par du 'phags pa mi rnyed kyis(nye/ ma la bdag gis 'di kho na la sbyin par bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ khyim pa rnams kyi khyim pa'i chos gang yin pa de bzhin du byas te/ bu mo de de la byin nas dbang phyug chen por yang bskos so/ /de yang de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do / /de nas phyi zhig na/ bu mo de la bu chags nas de zla ba dgu'am bcu lon pa dang khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta〈nyan sdug la mdzes pa zhig btsas te/ de'isabatsas ston 8rgyas par byas nas khye'u 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes liming 'dogs par byed de8/ khye'u 'di rus kā t+yā ya na yin la 'dus mo'i bu7yin pas na 'dus pa'i kā t+yā ya na zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de nas khye'u 'dus 73—102

pa'i kā t+yā ya na 'o ma dang / zho dang mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying gus7bskyed bsrings te/ mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de nas de gang gi tshe cher skyes pa de'i tshe yi ge dang bram ze'i spyod lam dang spyod pa dang / okuzhes bya ba dang / bho zhes bya ba dang / gtsang sbra dang /cho ga dang / thal ba blang ba dang / ril ba thogs pa dang / nges brjod kyi rig byed dang / mchod sbyin gyi rig byed dang / snyan tshig gi rig byed dang /srid srung gi rig byed dang / mchod sbyin bya ba dang / mchod sbyin byed du gzhug pa dang / sbyin pa dang / blang ba dang / kha ton⑧bya ba dang / kha ton slob tu gzhug pa'i thabs bslabs nas las rnam pa drug la mkhas pa'i bram zer gyur te/ de mthar gyis rig pa'i gnas bcwasabargyad la byang bar gyur to/ /des lo bcu drug lon nas bstan bcos thams cad rtogs te/ gzhung smra ba thams cad tshar bcad nas de'i blo 'di lta bu zhig skyes te/ 'dzam bu'i7gling na bdag dang mnyam pa yang med na lhag pa lta ci smos snyam du rlom pa des skye bo phal po che la khyad du gsod par byed do/ /de nas dge bsnyen zhig gis de la smras pa/ khye'u khyod bdagashedang mnyam pa su yang med na/ lhag pa lta ci smos snyam du rlom pa 'dis rgyags par ma byed cig /khye'u yul dbus na shākya'i bu zhig skyes pa de bram ze ltas mkhan bye brag phyed pa rnams kyis lung bstan te galashogacite khyim na gnas na ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /gal te skra dang kha spu bregs te chos gos tshon can bgos nas yang dag pa'i dad pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung na ni/ 'jig rten du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasakyisgra cher grags par 'gyur ro zhes 73—103

lung bstan pa las de sna/skra dang kha spu bregs te chos gos tshon can bgos nas yang dag pa'i dad pa kho nas khyim nas khyim na med par rab tu byung ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de la ni/khyod kyi gzugs dang shes rab kyis kyang brgya'i char yang mi phod stong gi char yang mi phod/ 'bum gyi char yang mi phod/ khrag khrig gi char yang mi phod de/grangs su bgrang du yang med do zhes byas so/ /de nas khye'u des sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra sngon ma thos pa thos nas spu thams cad zing zhes byas te lta 'dod par gyur to/ /de nas des pha ma la gsol te/ yab yum bdag yul dbus su mchis te/ bcom ldan 'das de'i thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad par 'tshal gyis 45)gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes byas so/ /de nas pha ma gnyis kyi ④ bsams pa/ 'di ni bdag cag gis bzlog par mi nus so snyam du rig nas smras pa/ sdod cig dang bdag cag gnyis kyis khyim gyi 'khor btang nas de'i 'og tu lhan cig tu 'dong zil bcom ldan 'das de'i thad du tshangs par spyod pa5sto spyad par bya'o zhes de skad smras nas/ de gnyis kyis khyim gyi 'khor btang ste sbyin pa dag byin zhing bsod nams dag byas nas yul dbus su dong ste/ de dag mthar gyis dong dong ba las rgyal po'i khaba'ime)tu phyin nas de dag bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ba dang / khye'u de dang de'i pha ma gnyis kyis thag ring po zhig nas / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu du'o rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan cing spa bar byas pa/ me lus kyi dbyibs su 'dug pa lta bu/ me lce mar gyis btab pa lta bu/ mar me gser gyi snod du bzhag pa lta bu/ mchod sdong rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa lta bu/ blo gsal 73—104

zhing dri ma med la rnam par dag pa ༅)dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang mchog tu dga' ba skyes te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i sems can gyis/ dang po sangs rgyas mthong ba'i nyams bde ba ci 'dra ba de lta bum ni lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du zhi gnas kyi sems la goms par byas pa la yang nyams bde ba de lta bu skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar mthong nas kyang mchog tu dga' ba skyes so/ /dga' ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das ga la bas der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ de rnams kyi bsam pa dang bag la nyal54 dang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te(nya/ de rnams kyis stan de nyid la 'khod bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ /de rnams kyis bden pa mthong nas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar 6)nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 7logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /btsun pa bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen na par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thob tu rung na/bdag cag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad par 'tshal lo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de gnyis 9)dge slong tshur shog ces bya bas rab tu phyungatshamaste bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de gnyis la lung yang phog ste / de gnyis kyis kyang brtson pa dang / bsgrubartso /stopa dang / 'bad pas nyon 73—105

mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong b.ratumanyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil7du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan spangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur ste la rgyab kyis phyogs pa/dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjedasnyepa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas 'dus mo yang bcom ldan 'das kyis skye dgu'ishībabadag mo chen morabago ta sī la gtad yinas/ de yang des rab tu phyung ste/ bsnyen57)par rdzogs par byas nas de la lung yang phog ste/ des kyang brtson pa dang bsgruba'ad pa dang 'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid tsholamangon sum du byas so/ /de nas dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa 'dus pa'i kā t+yā ya nas las ci bgyis na/ las de'i stunam par smin pas phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skyes te/ gzugs bzang zhing blta na7sdug la mdzes pa dang bstan bcos thams cad rtogs te gzhung smra ba thams cad tshar bcad la/ 'dis bcom ldan 'das kyang mnyes par bgyis te mi hunyemanyes par ma bgyis pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis pa dang / de'i pha ma gnyis kyang gzhung smra ba'i mchog tu gyur te/ 'di nyid la brten nas bcom ldan 'das mnyes par bgyis te mi mnyes par ma bgyis la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 73—106

la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ smon lam gyi dbang las gyur to/ /btsun pa 'di rnams kyis gang du smon lam btab lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal hu)pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i7tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i kha lo sgyurakhub/bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sī na bram ze zhig gnas pa des thabs zlar bab pa las chung ma blangs pa las/ phyi zhig na de'i chung ma la bu chags nas de zla ba dgu'am bcu lon pa dang khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta khrun sdug la mdzes pa zhig btsas nas/ 'o ma dang zho dang / mar dang zhun mar dang ske/ mar gyi nying gusakhebaskyed bsrings te/ mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de nas de cher skyes nas des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la dad pa rnyed nas pha ma gnyis la gsol te/yab yum bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung bar gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes byas so/ /de nas pha ma gnyis kyis de la smras pa/ bu khyod bdag cag gnyis kyi bu gcig pa sdug cing yid du 'ong la phongs pa dang 'thun par byed pa yin pas na bdag cag gnyis kyis nyaganang bar byar mi rung ngo zhes byas so/ /'on kyang de pha ma gnyis kyis thabs sna tshogs kyis bzlog ma nus nas de pha ma gnyis kyis gnang ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 73—107

'od srung gi gsung rab tshol rab tu byung nas bsnyen par rdzogs te/ des sde snod gsum bslabs nas/ rig tsho pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa dang ldan pa'i chos smra bar gyur te/ gos dang zas dang / mal cha dang stanas dang / nad gsos dang sman zong rnams rnyed do/ /de nas des pha ma gnyis dad pa phun sum tshogs pa la bkod 4)de/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams la gnas par byas nas/ de gnyis sbyin pa dang sbyin pa'i bgo bsha' la btsud do/ /de nas phyi zhig na des bsams pa bdag gis thos pa'i sgo nas bya ba gang yin pa de ni bdag gis byas zin gyis gerim la da ni bdag gis dge 'dun gyi zhal ta chos bzhin du bya'o snyam nas des pha ma gnyis dang sbyin bdag dang sbyin pa po gzhan dag la bskul nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'od srung la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la nebashos gsol te/ dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten rnams la bkur sti byas nas/ smon lam btab pa/ kye ma dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis na bdag gang dang 7)gang du skye ba de dang der phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skye bar shog cig /gzugs bzang zhing bltamacho rin sdug la mdzes par shog cig ces byas so/ /de gang las rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po des ni lo bcu drug lon pa ༄9rin/ bstan bcos thams cad rtogs nas gzhung smra ba thams cad kyang tshar bcad do/ /de bzhin du de'i pha ma gnyis kyang gzhung smra ba'i mchog tu gyur te gzhung smra ba thams cad tshar bcad do/ /de nas des smras pa /— ri/ ji ltar na bdag gi mkhan pos lo bcu drug lon pa na bstan /1bcos thams cad rtogs nas gzhung smra ba thams cad tshar bcad pa dang / de bzhin du de'i pha ma gnyis kyang gzhung smra ba'i mchog tu gyur te/ de gnyis kyis sna kyang gzhung smra ba thams cad 73—108

tshar bcad pa7de bzhin du bdag gis kyang52lo bcu drug kho na lon pa na bstan bcos thams cad rtogs par gyur cig /gzhung smra ba thams cad tshar gcodadzaXpar gyur cig /de bzhin du bdag gi pha ma gnyis kyang gzhung7smra ba thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur cig /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis/bram ze'i khye'u bla ma lung bstan pa gang yin pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bdag gis mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed parasnyim gyur cig /de kho na'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom nyid mngon sum du byed par gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas de smon lam 'debs shing 'dug pa pha ma gnyis kyis mthong nas de gnyis kyis de la dris pa/ bu khyod kyis smon lam ci zhig btab de nas des pha ma gnyis la bdag gis smon lam 'di ltar btab po zhes rgyas par bsnyad7do/ /pha ma gnyis kyis smras pa/ de'i ts+tsha bdag cag gnyis khyod kyi pha ma gzhung smra ba'i〈mchog tu gyur cig /khyod kyang bdag cag gnyis kyikebur gyur cig /khyod kho na la brten shete bdag cag gnyis kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig /de kho na'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji )snyam du sems/ de'i tshe yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i dge slong du gyur pa/ gang yin pa de ni 'dus pa'i kā kyā ya na 'di nyid yin no//de'i tshe de'i pha mar gyur pa gnyis ni pha ma 'di gnyis77kho na yin no/ /des der sbyin pa dag byin cing bsod nams dag byas nas smon lam btab pa'i las 73—109

de'i rnam par smin pas/ gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skyes te/ gzugs bzang zhing blta7na sdug la mdzes pa dang / bstan bcos thams cad kyang rtogs la/ gzhung smra ba thams cad kyang tshar bcad de/ dge slong dag nga yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung dang shin tu mnyam pa dang shugs mnyam pa dang mdzad pa mnyam pa dang thabs mnyam pa brnyes par gyur nas/ 'dis nga mnyes par byas te mi mnyes par ma byas la/ nga nyid kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pasanyid mngon sum du byas so/ /pha ma de gnyis kyis der smon lam btab ste/ bdag cag gnyis khyod kyi pha ma gzhung smra ba'i mchog tu gyur cig /khyod lasashebarten te bdag cag gnyis kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas pa des ni da ltar yang 'di gnyis gzhung smra ba'i mchog tu gyur te/ 'di nyid las nga brten nas 'di gnyisasnyikyis nga mnyes par byas te/mi mnyes par ma byas la/ nga nyid kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so// //tshem bu mkhan zhes bya ba ni/ gleng gzhi7mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag cigasheganas pa las phyi zhig na de'i chung ma la bu chags nas de zla ba dgu'am bcu lon pa dang khye'u zhig btsas te/ khye'u de yang 'phye bo 'gro ri mi nus pa zhig tu gyur te de'i btsas ston rgyas par byas nas/khye'u 'di'i ming nyuci boskad gdags zhes5)ming 'dogs par byed de/ khye'u 'di therte'aphye bo yin pas na 5 /khye'u 'di'i ming 'phye bor gdags so/ /de nas khye'u 'phye 73—110

bo 'o ma dang zho dang mar dang zhun mar dngatumar gyi nying gusashebaskyed bsrings te/ de gang gi tshesacher skyes pa de'i tshe phas bsams pa/ bdag gis khye'u 'di ci nas 'dug bzhin du las byed cing bzo des 'tsho ba rnyed par 'gyur ba'i bzomang)ji lta bu zhig bslab par bya5lde)snyam mo/ /de nas des bsams pa ma la bdag gis kyi'adi tshem bu mkhan gyi las bslabs pa dang des 'di'i 'tsho ba rnyed par 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas/ des7khye'u delo)tshem bu mkhan gyi las slob tu bcug go/ /de nas de yang de la slob dpon gyi mchog tu gyur to/ /de nas dus ston zhig byed pa na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis chung ma'i phyir gzhan gyi khyim nas gos dang rgyan g.yar por blangs nas/ khyer te 'ongs te chung ma des kyang bgos nas dus ston la chas te song ngo / /de nas de bag med pas de'i zhu gcig gis dral to / /de nas de khyim thab kyis 'jigs nas su la yang ma bstan te dus ston las phyir log nas khyim bdag de grong gzhan zhig tu song ngo / /de song nas budam/stomed des tshem bu mkhan de bdag gis 'khyim du blangs te/ sus kyang mi mthong bar bya ba'i phyir sgo bcad nas zhu7de drub tu bcug pa dang / tshem bu mkhan gyisakhyim du blangs pa'i rjes la khyim thab rang gi khyim du 'ongs nas sgo rdung zhing 'bod do/ /de nas de'i chung mas skad las ngo shes nas tshem bu mkhan rang gi khyim du bzhag pa dang / zhu dral ba'i phyir shas cher 'jigs pa skyes nas de 'jigs shing skrag pas/ tshem bu mkhan de khong du chud par byas te gzeb kyi nang du gcugatsonas gzeb rgyas btab ste bzhag go/ /de nas sgo phye ste khyim thab nang du 'ongs nas kha gsag〈nyebyas te ci rigs par bsnyen bkur byas nas de dang lhan cig tu nyal lo/ /de gnyis nyal ba dang rkun po dag cig gis khyim phug nas nang 73—111

du 'ongs te thog ma kho 1)nar gzeb de las zin nas/ de dag 'di snyam du sems te gzeb 'di 'di ltar rgyas legs par btab la lci bshelas nasanor bu rin po che chen po yod gor ma chag go/ /'dis ni bdag cag mi rabs bdun gyi bar du yang chog par 'gyur te/ 'di kho nas bdag cag chog gis5gebadag cag la rdzas gzhan mi dgos so snyam sridu bsams nas/ de dag gis gzeb de gcig pu khyer te phyir phyung phyinas nags 'dab tu 7)khyer ro/ /de dag 'dong ba na zla ba yang shar la mi des kyang de'i nang na 'dug bzhin du 6)gcin shor nas gcin7de gzeb las thar te phyi rol du zags 7so/ /de nas rkun po de dag 'di5nyasnyam du sems te 'di ltar zla ba shar ba na/ 'di'i nang nas chu 'bab pa las na/ 'di'i nang du ni nor 12bu chu shel bcug yang dag snyam ste/ lhag par7yang snying dga' bar gyur to/ /de nas de dag gis7sha thang ste gzeb de khyer nas nags 'dab tu gelhags so/ /de nas mi rgod kyi sde dpon dang mi rgod gzhan dag gis dris pa/ khyod kyis gzeb 'di'i nang du ci zhig khyer te 'ongs/ de dag gis smras pa/ sde sadapon deng du ni bdag cag gis thams cad kyi dbul ba'i rgyun bcad kyis 1 dgyes pa bskyed du gsol/ deng bdag cag gis rin po ches gang ba'i gzeb rnyed do zhes byas so/ /de nas de thos ma thag tu de dag kyang snying dga' bar gyur te smras pa/ gzeb phye zhig dang 'dir rin po che ji lta bu dag bcug pa blta'o zhes byas so/ /de nas de dag gis gzeb de bgrol5snyenas kha phye 19ste bltas na 3 rigazeb de'i nang du 'phye bo 27zhig bcug cing 'dug pa mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu der song song ba dang gzab de khyer khyer ba gang yin pa de dag ni 'phye bo 'dis bdag cag mtshan thog thag nyenyon mongs so snyam 73—112

nas sdug bsngal bar gyur to/ /der ma dong ba gang yin pa de dag gis ni mi rgod der song song ba de dag la gad mo chen pos btab nas smras pa/ legs par nyon mongs so/ /shin tu nyon mongs so zhes byas7)so/ /de nas bud med de sad de langs nas khang pa de'i nang du songashon/ba dang / khyim phug ste gzeb rkusam pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang snying dga'algenas tshigs su bcad de smras pa / khang pa phug nas gzeb kyang stor/ /bdag ni byed dga' phyed mi dga'/ /nags 'dabs song ba'i rkun po rnams/ / de ni dgodar )cing ngu bar 'gyur/ /zhes byas so/ /de nas der mugazeb de khyer te 'ongs pa gang yin pa de dag khros te smras pa/ 'di ltar 'phye bo 'dis bdag cag mi dga' bar byas mod kyi/'on kyang bdag cag gi gnod sbyin mchod dgos kyis52)bdag cag gis 'di kho nas gnod sbyin la mchod pa tshobya'o zhes/smras nas/ de dag gis gnod sbyin de'i mdun du ba lang gi lci bas dkyil 'khor byas te/ bdug pa dang me tog dang mchod pa'i cho ga dang bum pa gang ba rnams bzhag nas ral gri rnon po thogs te / mi de gnod sbyin gyi mdun du bzhag nas mchod sbyin byas so/ /de nas mi des kyang ji ltar bdag nyid gnod sbyin de'i mchod par dbul bar chad pa khong du chud nas/ shin tu skrag ste/ bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtogs pa gzhan 37su zhig la da bdag skyabasalasu 'gro bar bya/ su zhig bdag la srog phangs hunyepa sbyin par 'gyur snyam du bsams nas/ des bcom ldan 'das la sems kyis gsol ba btab pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ni 'di lta ste 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba ci yang mi gzigs pa dang mi mkhyen pa dang thugs su ma 8chud pa mi mnga' na/ kye ma bcom ldan 'das/73—113

bdag0)ni dkos )thag cing nyam nga las nophongs par gyur pa lags kyis bdag yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ srog phangs pa stsal du gsol zhes byas so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam ston pa rnam pa gnyis kyi shes bya dang ye shes la mnga' brnyes pa ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum la mkhas pa mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ 'gro ba lngar 'gro ba las rnam par grol ba/ skye mched drug la mkhas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la spyod yul ba/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la snyoms par 'jug pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ yang dag par seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogasalgepa rnams ni/ chos nyid kyis nyin dus gsum mtshan dus gsum ste/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/ su ni rgyad/ su ni dar/ su ni phongs shing 'dug /su ni nyam thag par gyur/ su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs pa dang nyam nga bas dang gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni ngan song du gzhol/su ni ngan song du 'bab/ su ni ngan song du babani/ su ni ngas ngan song nas phyung ste/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang 'bras bu la gzhag par bya/ su ni nyes par spyod pa'i 'dam du bying ba las lag nas drang bar bya/ su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun med pa las 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du gzhug par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ma bskyed7pa las bskyed par bya/su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed zin pa las yongs su smin par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su smin zin nyu 3pa las ye shes kyi mtshon gyis brtol bar bya/su la /1ni sangs rgyas byung bas 12brgyan pa'i 'jig rten 'bras bu dang bcas par 73—114

bya snyam du ye shesashegazigs pashe'ajug go/ /rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus rlabs7yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gzigs na/'phye bo de dang mi rgod lnga brgya po de rnams gdul ba'i dus la bab par thugs su chud nas/ lha'i sku gzugs de nyid las lha'i cha lugs su bzhugs so/ /de nas mi rgod lnga brgya 'di snyam du sems te/ lhas bdag cag la rang gi sku bstan to snyam ste/ spu zing zhes byas nas/ thal mo sbyar te 'khod nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bka' ci su55 bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ngasnyil mis mchod mi dgos kyisatswami'i mchod pa 'di thong shig /gal te khyedam kyichos 'dod na ni mchod pa gsol ba thong la 'khod cig dang chos bstan par bya'o//de nas de ltar 'tshal lo7zhes byas nas mi rgod de dag gis mchod pa btang nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te chos mnyan pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phye bo de dang mi rgod de dag gi she bsam pa dang bag la nyal 7dang khams dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ des na5)mi rgod lnga brgya po de dag gis stan de nyid la 'khod bzhin du 'jigatsha/)tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum dusngo byas so/ /'phye bo des kyang phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ /de nas mide dag gis bden pa mthong nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i cha lugs mi snang bar dzad nas rang bzhin gyi skur bzhugs so/ /de nas de dag gis bcom ldan 'das mthong nas lhag par yang dga' ba skyes so/ /dga' ba skyes nas stan 73—115

las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de nya)logs su thal 75)mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byungam rib dang bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thob btu rung na/ bdag cag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad par 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi rgod rnams la dge slong tshur shog tshangs par spyod cig ces bka' stsal pa'i mod la skra dang kha spu ni bregs nas/zhag bdun lon pa tsam du gyur spyod lam ni bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa lta bur 'dug par gyur nas lag na lhung bzed dang chu snod thogs par gyur to/ /'dir smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas tshur zhes bka' stsal pas/ /de ni mgo bregs lus la snam sbyar gyon/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni dgongs pas gosapo)bgos nas/ /mod la dbang po rab tu zhi bar gnas/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams la lung phog ste/ de dag gis kyang brtson pa dang bsgrub57pa dang 'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ de dag dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong 3bar mnyam pa nam mkha' dang lag mthil5gdu 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil ri bar gyur pa/rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur sti la rgyab kyis phyogs pa / dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed 11pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas 'phye bos 73—116

bsams pa/ gal te bdag kyang lus 'di 'dra bar ma gyur na ni bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ chu bo rnams las brgal 1bar bya ba dang sbyor ②ba rnams (5)las 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir brtson pa dang bsgrubalgepa dang 'bad par bya ba zhig na snyam mo/ /de nas de skad ces brjod ma thag tu de'i lus de rnam pa thams cad du yongs su rdzogs shing rangs par gyur nas de lhag par yang bcom ldan 'das la dga' bar gyur to/ /dga' bar gyur nas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung 5ba dang 6)bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thob tu rung na/ bdag kyang 7bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad par 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong tshur shog ces bya bas rab tu phyung ste bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas lung yang phog go/ /des kyang brtson pa dang bsgrub (pa dang 'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /de nas dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa btsun pa 'phye bos las ci zhig shebagyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas 'phye bor gyur lags/ las ci zhig bgyis na/ des bcom ldan 'das mnyes par bgyis te mi mnyes par ma bgyis la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag 'di nyid kyis las de (1lta bu byas shing bsags te dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i 12tshe 73—117

lo nyi khri thub pa na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu gdul bya'ishes lo sgyur ba / bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi7ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung ⑧zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sī 'di nyid na khyim bdag spun gnyis shig gnas pa las gcig gis ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung las chos ④thos te phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas nas/ des kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa'i las rnams spangs te/gcig tu nges par kha na ma (5)tho ba med pa'i las rnams la gnas so/ /nu bo cig shos ⑥ni zhing las 47)byed de des bsams pa bdag ni grang ba na yang grang bas nyen tsha ba 48)na yang tsha bas nyen la/ 'di ni khyim na 'dug cing bde ba nyams su myong bar byed do snyam nas/ de khros te phyir mi 'ong ba de la tshig rtsub po smras pa/ bdag ni grang ba na yang grang bas nyen tsha ba na yang7tsha bas nyen te las thams cad byed la khyod ni 'phye bo7bzhin du khyim na then zhing 'dug ste ci yang byed pa mi 'dod dam zhes byas so/ /de nas phyir mi 'ong bas bsams pa/nu bo 'dis bdag la tshig rtsub po smras kyis tsogatan du phung bar mi 'gyur b.ramatsho/)bya ba'i phyir 'di'i ra mda' 8bya dgos so snyam nas des7de'i mdun du rdzu 'phrul bstan te smras pa/ khyod kyis nga la tshig rtsub po smras kyis7nyes pa la nyes so zhes bshags par gyis shig /'khor ba na 'khor zhing sdug bsngal chen po rnyed tarwa re/ de nas de〈nyethos ma thag tu nu bo de 'gyod pa chen po skyes te/ des de'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal nas bzod par (tshegasol te 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag khyim na gnas pa btang ste/ song la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 73—118

'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu 'byungashingo / /phyir mi 'ong bas smras pa/ khyim gyi 'khor thong la7bdag cag gnyis ka rab tu 'byung bar bya'o/ /des smras pa/de ltar bgyi'o/ /de nas des khyim gyi 'khor btang nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la gnyi gas rab tu byung ste/ phyir mi 'ong bas ni rab tu byungasnyinas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /cigasheshes kyis ni rab tu byung nas tshe gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad de 'chi kur7smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis 'di ltar sems can dag pa 'di lta bu la tshig rtsub po smras pa'i las de'i skal ba can du bdag ma gyur cig /brgya la las de'i 'bras bu bdag la smin par gyurashen yang rab tu 'byung ba'i sems bskyed ma thag tu ma legs pa med par gyur 9)te legs pa 'o'abyung bar gyur cig /'di ltar bdag rab tu byung nas tshe gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad kyang yon tan ci yang ma thob kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma lung bstan parwategang yin pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bdagasagis mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par7byed par ma gyur cig /de kho na'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gsung rab la rab tu byung ba'i dge slong du gyur pa gang yin pa de ni 'phye bo 'di nyid yin te/ des der phu bo la tshig rtsub po smras pa'i las des ni gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der 'phye bor gyur to/ /de 'gyod par gyur te rab tu byung nas tshe gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad de 73—119

'chi kur01smon lam btab pa/ 'di ltar bdag gis sems can dag pa 'di lta bu la tshig rtsub po tsho smras pa'i las de'i skal ba can du bdag ma gyur cig /brgya la las de'i rnam par smin pa bdag la smin ༷ skupar gyur na yang rab tu 'byung ④ba'i sems bskyed ma thag tu bdag gi 55)ma legs pa med par gyur te/ legs pa 'byung 6)bar gyur cig ces byas pa des ni da ⑦ltar rab tu byung ba'i sems bskyed ma thag tu lus kyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur to/ /des der smon lam btab ste yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis/bram ze'i khye'u bla ma lung bstan pa gang yin pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bdag gis mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par5nyebyed par ma gyur cig /de kho na'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par gyur cig ces byas pas ni/ dge slong dag nga yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung dang shin tu mnyam pa dang shugs mnyam pa dang mdzad pa mnyam pa dang thabs mnyam pa brnyes par gyur nas/ 'dis nga mnyes par byas tem7mi mnyes paramakhom byas la nga nyid kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /de nas dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa kye ma mi rgod lnga brgya po 'di dag 'phye bo 'di dang mjalam/gle nas rab tu byung ste/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag da ltar 'ba' zhig ma yin gyi 'das pa'i dus na yang mi rgod lnga brgya po 'di tu dag 'phye bo 'di nyid dang phrad nas rab tu byung ste/ bsam 73—120

gtan bzhi dang mngon par shes pa lnga bskyed pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na mi rgod lnga brgya tsam nags khrod cig na rten cing gnas te/ de dag gis ri khrod kyi grong zhig bcom ste/ nor zas mang po de nas blangs so/ /mi 'di yang nagasamanye)khrod de nyid na rten cing 'dug pa las mi rgod de dag der dong bas 3riganod sbyin las rimi mchod pa'i phyir bzung ste/ de dag nags khrod der dong nas gnod sbyin de'i mdun du ba lang gi lci bas byugs te / bum pa gang ba dang mi de bzhag nas ral gri rnon po thogs te/ gnod sbyin gyi mdun du 'dug nas mchod sbyin byas so/ /mi des kyang bdag 'di rnams kyis bsad de gnod sbyin gyi mchod pa byed par sems sams snyam nas de shin tu 'jigs shing skrag par gyur to/ /'jigs shing skrag nas bsams pa/bdag su zhig la skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ bdag la su zhig srog phangs pa sbyin par 'gyur snyam mo/ /de nas de'i tshe ri khrod de nas thag mi ring ba zhig na dka' thub kyi gnas shig gi nang na 5drang srong zhig gnas so/ /de'i tshe mi des drang srong de yid la dran nas des dad pa'i sems kyis drang srong de la gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni mi gzigs pa dang / mi mkhyen pa dang /thugs su 6 mi chud pa ci yang mi mnga' na kye ma bdag la srog phangs pa stsal du gsol / dka' ba sku nyams su bzhes par gsol zhes byas so/ /de nas drang srong de la medaga' ba'i lha zhig gis mi de'i bsam pa sems kyis shes nas drang srong de la sbran to/ /de nas drang srong gis thos ma thag tu rang gi dka' thub kyi gnas nas mi snangs bar gyur te/ mi rgod de dag gi mdun shedu 'ongs nas mi rgod de dag gis drang srong de mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de dag mchog tu 73—121

dga' bar gyur to/ /dga' bar gyur nas drang srong bka' ci stsal zhes byas so/ /drang srong gis smras pa/ mi 'di thong la nga'i mdun du 'khod cig dang khyod la chos bshad do/ /de nas drang srong gis bka' stsal pa bzhin du 'tshal lo zhes smras nas/ mi rgod de dag gis mi de btang ste/ drang srong de'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal nas chos mnyan pa'i phyir mdun du 'khod do/ /de nas drang srong des de dag la chos de lta bu bstan te des na7mi de dang mi rgod lnga brgya drang srong de nyid kyi thad du rab tu byung nas/ bsamashegatan bzhi dang mngon par shes pa lnga bskyed do/ /dge slong dag jishesnyam du sems/ de'i tshe drang srong du gyur pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas par gyur pa gang yin pa de ni nga yin no/ /de'i tshe mi gang yin pa de ni 'phye bo 'di nyid yin no/ /mi rgod lnga brgyar gyur pa gang yin pa de dag ni mi rgod lnga brgya po 'di dag nyid yin te/de'i tshe 'di rnams kyis mi de las brten nas rab tu byung ste bsam gtan bzhi dang mngon par shes pa lnga bskyed do/ /da ltar yang 'phye bo 'di nyid la brten nas rab tu byung steshenyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /las brgya pa las sdom gyi tshigs su bcad⑥pa dang po rdzogs sospa// // las brgya tham pa/ bam po lnga pa/ sdom ni/ shing rta bzhi dang sgamasnyepo dang ske/ /sa 'tsho skra ldan pad ma'imakhamadog /shan pa gser mdog ba lang rdzi/ /mdza' sde 'jigs med dbyig mtsho dang / /dbyig dga' dang ni dom gnyis dang ske/ /skur chung dang ni tha ma srin/ /shing rta bzhi zhes bya ba la/ /shing rta 73—122

dang po ni/ gleng gzhi mnyan she7du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bram ze zhigane mchod sbyin byed par 'dod de shing rta la zhon nas mnyan du yod par song ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyang snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te/ lhung bzed bsnams nas mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms la gshegs pa dang / de dga' ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la bskor ( ba byas te song ngo / /de'i skabs su bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang /bsdus 'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang /rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol dang / so thams thams pa5gedang / kyi hud zer ba dang / a chu zer ba dang /ud pal ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas/ tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo/ khrang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang7yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /des na sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to④/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/kye ci'ubadag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed7pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed5)par mdzad de⑩/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye bdag 73—123

cag ni 'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi 'on kyang sngon ma byung 1)ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad den/ lha dang mi rnams kyi nang dudzaXgang du bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der 4nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang / sum cu ga rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral ba rnams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams dang /'phrul dga' rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i 6)mdun na 'don pa rnams dang97)/ tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang /dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang /'bras bu che 8rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang /gya nom snang ba 9 rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba tsharnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang ske/ bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so/1/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjodam skupar byed de/ nges par 'byung ba brtsam par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor 1debar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni//skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur zhes 73—124

rjod7par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyi bzhin 'brang dun/ste/gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i (gulas lung ston ④par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na yin/ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthemanyabor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar57)'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur snomi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu7)lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor bsngo1byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te/bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang 73—125

po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun du snang bar bgyis//nyi ma shar bas /)ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin/ /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ /rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes ( spangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi dam pa'is rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis paral/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan po nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge sbyong rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gegasung mchog brtan⑧pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tshom dzi skyes pa bsal bar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs tsunasangs rgyas rnams gyin dashe'adzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod la skye bo phal chenashenyan par 'tshal/ /'brug sgra lta bu'i gsung ldan pa/ /khyu mchog lta bu'i lta stangasasku can/ /mi mchog mchod pa bgyid pa yi/ /'bras bu cir 'gyur lung bstan gsol/ /btsun pa de bzhin gshegs07pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu ma mchis rkyen ma limachis par 'dzum pa ston par mi mdzad na/ 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags rkyen gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' nyurtebo de ni 8de bzhin no/ /de ni gede bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu dang rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis bram ze gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa la bskor ba byas te song ba mthong ngamatsha/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo bram ze 'di ni dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bskal pa bcu gsum gyi bar du 73—126

log par ltung bar mi 'gyur te/ bskal pa bcu gsum gyi bar du lha rnams dang /mi rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams sbyar7)zhing / 'khor bar gyur nas srid pa tha ma dang gnas tha ma la mir skye ba thob ste rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur zhosal/ des slob dpon med pa dang man ngag med par byang chub kyi phyogs dang 'thun pa'i chos sum cu gertsa bdun mngon du byas nas rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon sum du byed par 'gyur te/ rang sangs rgyas skor〈gebyed ces bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos55tsho/ni de yin no// //shing rta gnyis pa ni/ gleng gzhi mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bram ze'i khye'u zhig gis mchod sbyin byas nas shing rta la zhon te 'khor gyi tshogs kyis g.yog byas nas mnyan du yod pa'i nang du chas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms mdzadashenas/ mnyan du yod pa nas slar gshegs pa dang de dga' ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la bltas so/ /de'i skabs su bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum ⑦pa mdzad de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang thig nag dang /bsdus 'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang /rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol dang ske/ so'uthams thams dang / kyi hud zer ba ⑩dang / a chu zer ba hu 7dang / ud pal ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma 73—127

ltar gas pa chen por song nas/ tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu bsil bar gyur te 'bab 1bo/ /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni padro bar gyur te 'bab bo/ / des na57sems can de dag gi )gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil (de bar gyur to/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma 6ci bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du yang 7ma skyes mod kyis)/ 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus/ bdag cag gis gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon paral dga' bar gyur nas sems can dmyal ba 1 myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad de lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden pa rnams kyi snod512du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang / sum cu sgom gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral rnams dang /dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don rnams dang —/ tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal tshanams dang / dge chung rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin skyemed rnams dang / bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che 1 rnams dang / mi che bsngo/rnams dang /73—128

mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya rnam snang rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang ske/ 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas mi rtag pa0)dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs so / /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjodam par byed de/ nges par 'byung ba btsam par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar ca)gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod 5)par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyi bzhin 'brang ste/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar ca/lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu 73—129

lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams7kyi mdzod spur mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur mi snang bar gyur totsho / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 5)thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yisasnyephyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyis/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin / /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes 5spangs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi dam pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung ⑥mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan po nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na / /dge sbyong7rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung mchog brtan pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tshom skyes pa bsal bar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan⑧pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin dam1)'dzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod la skye tsobo phal chen hu)nyan par 'tshal /'brug sgra lta bu'i gsung ldan pa/ /khyu mchog lta bu'i lta stangs can/ /mi mchog mchod pa bgyid pa yi/ /'bras bu cir/'gyur lung bstan gsol/ /btsun pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 73—130

ni rgyu ma mchis rkyen ma mchis par 'dzum pa ston par mi mdzad na/ btsun pa 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ninyergyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis bram ze gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa la dga' ba skyes nas bltas pa mthong ngam btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo bram ze 'di ni dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bskal pa bcu gsum gyi bar du log par ltung bar mi 'gyur te/bskal pa bcu gsum gyi bar du lha rnams dang mi⑧rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams sbyarashezhing / 'khor bar gyur nas srid pa tha ma dang gnas tha ma la mir skye ba thob ste/ rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur la des slob dpon med pa dang man ngag med par byang chub kyi phyogs dang 'thun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa (babadun mngon du byas nas rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon sum du byed par 'gyur te/ rang sangs rgyas dga' ba zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni de yin no// //shing rta gsum pa ni/ gleng gzhipo)mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te/ lhung bzed bsnams nas mnyan4)du yod par bsod snyoms la gshegs so/ /bram ze zhig kyang shing rta la zhon te yul rgyu zhing chas pa las/ bcom ldan 'das mthong nas/ bkra mi shis so snyam ste phan tshun du bros so33/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / de la thugs brtse ba'i phyir de dang de kho na na0)bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas re zhig na 73—131

grong khyer gyi sgo bzhi char du gnye)yang de'i mdun na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs par gyur nas des bsams pa dge sbyong na gi ta ma 'di ni rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che5kyeb yin no snyam nas/ de bcom ldan 'das la dga' ba skyes so/ /de dga' ba skyes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du me tog spar gang gtor to/ /de'i skabs su bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad de/ 'di cani sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang ske/ bsdus 'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol ba 5dang / so thams thams phyidang / kyi hud zeram7)dang / a chu zer ba nadang / ud pal 9ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang /pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas/ tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo/ /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ni dro bar gyur te 'bab bo/ / des na 11sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to12/ /de nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ci bdag cag 'di nas 'chi 'phos sam 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du 73—132

yang ma skyes mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus bdag cagamanye )gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas/ sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad de/ lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du 'a)bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang / sum cus kyirtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral rnams dang / dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun zin 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung rnams dang /tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin med rnams dang /bsod nams skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu che rnams dang / mi chem rnams dang /mi gdungs rnams dang / gya rnam snang rnams dang / shin tu mthong rnams dang /'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nas/ mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang ske/ stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs sod / /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjod 9par byed de/ nges par 'byung ba brtsam par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ /gang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la/ /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjod 1 par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag 73—133

gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyi bzhin 'brang ste/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni/ zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams7kyi mdzod spur mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsumarkubaskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun du snang bar 73—134

bgyis①/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin/ /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes spangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi⑧dam pa'i rgyur〈 /gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub rnams ni rgyu rkyen ma mchis par/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung54)mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan ri po nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na6)/ /dge sbyong rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gisheni gsung mchog brtan rin pa dang ske/ /bzang po dag gis the tshom skyes pa bsal bar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtanaspyo)pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin da mi 'dzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod la skye bo phal chenamo/nyamanyan par 'tshal/ /'brug sgra lta bu'i gsung ldan pa/ /khyu mchog lta bu'i lta stangs can/rte/ /mi mchog mchod pa bgyid pa yi/ /'bras bu cir tso'agyur lung bstan gsol/ /btsun pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu ma mchis rkyen ma mchis par 'dzum pa ston par mi mdzad na/ btsun pa 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags rkyen gang lags bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis bram ze gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa la me tog gis gtor ba mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo bram ze ⑩'di ni dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bskal pa bcu gsum gyi bar du log par lhung bar mi 'gyur te/ bskal pa bcu gsum gyi bar du lha rnams 73—135

dang mi rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams sbyar zhingatu'akhor bar gyur nas/ srid pa tha ma dang gnas tha ma la mir skye ba thob ste rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur la des ②slob dpon med pa dang man ngag med par byang chub kyi phyogs dang 'thun pa'i chos sum cu )rtsa bdun mngon du byas nas/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon sum du byed par 'gyur te rang sangs rgyas me tog bla ma zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni de yin no// //shing rta bzhi pa ni/ gleng gzhi mnyan )du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das mnyan (5)du yod pa nas rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs so/ /bram ze zhig kyang shing rta la zhon te lam du snol mar 'gro ba las/ bram ze des bcom ldan 'das mthong nas shing rta las babs te bcom ldan 'das la shing rta bstabs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang de nyid la thugs brtse ba'i phyir/shing rta'i steng 6)gi nam mkha' la bzhugs so/ /de nas bram ze de7rgyu de las dga' ba chen po skyes so/ /dga' ba chen po skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thad nas song ngo / /de'i skabs su bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad don/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe/ 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang /dmar po dang / dkar po rnams byung nas kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng du 'gro'o/ /'og tu 'gro ba gang yin pa de dag ni/ sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / bsdus 'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang /ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang ske/ chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol ba ri9)dang / so thams thams tshadang /73—136

kyi hud zer ba rmenye dang / a chu zer ba dang / ud pal ltar gas pa dang /pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por song nas/ tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ri ni bsil bar gyur te 'bab bo /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang yin pa de dag tu ri ni dro bar gyur te 'bab bo / /des na sems can de dag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to④ / /de nas de dag 'di snyam du risems te/ kye ci bdag cag netsho'adi nas shi 'phos sam 'on te gzhan du skyes sam snyam mo/ /de nas de dag dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das sprul pa 'gyed par mdzad 7de/ de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ kye bdag cag ni 'di nas kyang na shi 'phos par ma gyur la gzhan du yang ma skyes mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon ma byung ba'i sems can snang ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi gnod pa'i khyad par rnams rtse zhil bar gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dga' bar gyur nas sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad de/ lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du gang du bden pa rnams kyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ba der nying mtshams she 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /steng du 'gro ba gang 3 yin pa de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris rnams dang sum cu 1rtsa gsum rnams dang 'thab bral rnams dang dga' ldan rnams dang / 'phrul dga' rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams dang / tshangs ris rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun 12na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung rnams dang / tshad med 'od rnams dang / 'od gsal rnams dang / dge chung 1 rnams dang /tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas rnams dang / sprin samed rnams dang /73wa 137

bsod nams7skyes rnams dang / 'bras bu chekhurnams dang / mi chesnyernams dang —/ mi gdungasarnams dang / gya rnam snang5gernams dang / shin tu mthongasnyurnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi bar du song nasaX/ mi rtag pa dang /sdus bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs sol/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang rjodamaX par byed de/ nges par 'byung ba brtsam par gyis / /sangs rgyas bstan la sbyor bar gyis/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin / /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par gyis/ zhagang zhig chos 'dul 'di nyid la / /bag yod spyod par byed pa ni/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rjodarwa1par byed do/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskor nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi phyi bzhin 'brang ste gal te (2bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi ting par mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston 8par bzhed na ni pus mo gnyis su mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lhar skye bar lung ston 73—138

par bzhed na ni lte bar mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur mi snang bar 'gyur rol/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tor du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams7kyi mdzod spurang mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ tshon sna stong gis spel ba sna tshogs can/ /mang po zhal gyi sgo nas byung bar gyur/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun du snang bar bgyis/ /nyi ma shar bas ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin/ /yang tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgod dang bral zhing rgyags dang mi dgyes spangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba dag gi dam pa'i rgyur57gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thub7rnams ni rgyu rkyen na〉ma mchis par/ /pad ma'i rtsa dang dung mdog lta bu'i 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan po nyid kyi blo yis dus bab mkhyen lags na/ /dge sbyong rgyal dbang nyan pa som nyi 'tshal ba rnams/ /thub pa khyu mchog gi ni gsung mchog brtan pa dang / /bzang po dag gis the tshom skyes pa bsal bar gsol/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams gyin dmanya'adzum mi ston/ /gang gi don du dpa' bo 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /de ni khyod la skye bo phal chen 3)nyan par 'tshal/ /'brug sgra lta bu'i gsung ldan padu/ /khyu mchog lta bu'i lta stangs can/ /mi mchog mchod pa bgyid pa yi/ /'bras bu cir 'gyur lung bstan gsol/ /btsun pa de bzhin gshegs 73—139

pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu ma mchis rkyen ma mchis par 'dzum pa ston par mi mdzad na/ btsun pa 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang 1lags rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad do/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis bram ze gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa la shing rta bstabs pa mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags sol/ /kun dga' bo bram ze 'di ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bskal pa bcu gsum gyi bar du log par ltung bar mi 'gyur te/ bskal pa bcu gsum gyi bar du lha rnams dang mi rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams sbyar zhing na)'khor bar gyur nas srid pa tha ma dang gnas tha ma la mir skye ba thob ste rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur la / des slob dpon med pa dang man ngag med par byang chub kyi phyogs dang 'thun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun mngon du byas nas/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon sum du byed par 'gyur te/ rang sangs rgyas shing rta sbyin zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyin par bya ba'i chos ni 'di yin no// //sgam po zhes bya ba ni/ gleng gzhi rinomanyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe sems can zhig lasems can dmyal bar skyes te lus che zhing dmus long du 'dug la de'i lus ril gyis mas zhu lub tu yog ste/ de'i spyi bo man chad rkang mthil yan chad srin zhugs pas de nad ma bzod nas phan tshun rgyug par byed la/de gal te thang la 'gro na ni/ de la de nyid nas seng ge dang / stag dang /gzig dang / dred la sogs pa lcags kyi mche ba can dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/73—140

de dag gis de'i sha rnams bcad cing bcad cing 6)za'o/ /de ste chu la 'bog na ni de la de nyid nas chu srin ma ka ra lcags kyi mche ba can dag ②'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag gis kyang de'i sha rnams bcad cing bcad cing0)za'o de ste steng gi nam mkha' la 'gro na ni de la de nyid nas/ bya rog dang bya rgod dang chun lag lcags kyi mchu can dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag gis kyang de'i sha rnams bcad cing bcad cing za'o/ /de ste nags stug gepo'i nang du 'gro na ni de la de nyid nas shing shal ma li'isdomatshal 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de la der ral gri dang / mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / mdung kha leb rnams rlung gis spags nate de'i steng du 'bab bo/ /de ste rtsig pa'i gseb bam ri'i sul lam bya skyibs dag tu 'gro bar 'dod na yang de la de nyid nas las las skyes pa'i mi dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ ral gri dang /mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa na dang / mdung kha leb rnams thogs nas de'i lus la 'debs te/ de dag gis de'i lus thams cad bcad 1)cing gtub par byed de/ rgyu des na des sdug bsngal drag pa dang mi bzad pa dang tsha ba dang yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshorarwanyab myong ste/ nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin cing ngu'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bgrod pa gcig pu'i nyanalam ston pa/ rnam pa gnyis kyi shes bya dang ye shes la mnga' brnyes pa/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhagate/nyepa gsum la mkhas pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis me 'jigs pa/ 'gro ba lngar 'gro ba las rnam par grol ba/ skye mched drug la mkhas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la spyod yul bakhi/ rnam par thar bopa brgyad la bsam gtan pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la 73—141

snyoms par 'jug pa/ stobs bcu'i0)stobs dang ldan pa/ yang dag pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs rigepa rnams ni chos nyid kyis nyin dus gsum mtshan dus gsum ste/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/ su ni rgyad/ su ni dar/ su ni phongs shing 'dug /su ni nyam nga bar gyur/ su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs pa dang nyam nga ba dang gnod pa dang ldan su ni ngan song du gzhol su ni ngan song du 'bab su ni ngan song du bab su ni ngas tshangan song nas phyung ste mtho ris dang thar pa dang 'bras bu la gzhag par bya/ su ni nyes par spyod pa'i 'dam du bying ba las lag nas drang bar bya/ su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun med pa las 'phags pa'isnyinor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du gzhug par rin)bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ma bskyed pa las bskyed par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed zin pa las yongs su smin par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su min zin pa las ye shes kyi mtshon gyis brtol 6)bar bya/ su la gni sangs rgyas byung bas brgyan pa'i 'jig rten 'bras bu dang bcas par bya snyam du ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus rlabs yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs nas shen/ mnyan du yod pa'i skye bo phal po che 'dul ba'i dus la bab nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa ci tshar gcad spu pas 'dul bar 'gyur ram 'on te bstod pas 'dul bar 'gyur ram/ 'on te skyo ba bskyed pas 'dul bar 'gyur snyam du dgongs nas/ skyo ba bskyed pas 'dul bar 'gyur bar bcom ldan 'das kyis gzigs nas/ de dag skyo ba 73wa 142

bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can de rdzu 'phrul gyis bkug ste/chu klung khang ldan gyi 'gram du bzhag na1)/ der yang de nad mi bzod nas phan tshun rgyug par byed la der yang de gal te thang la 'gro na ni de la de'i nyid nas seng ge dang stagashedang / gzig dang dred la sogs pa lcags kyi mche ba can dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag gis de'i sha rnams bcad cing bcad cing za'o / /de ste chur 'bog na ni de la de nyid nas chu srin masnyika ra lcags kyi mche ba can dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag gis kyang de'i sha rnams bcad cing bcad cing za'o/ /de ste steng gi nam mkha' la 'gro na ni de la de nyid nas bya rog dang bya rgod dang chun lag lcags kyi mchu can dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/de dag gis kyang de'i sha rnams bcad cing bcad cing za'o/ /de ste nags stug 5po'i nang du 'gro na ni de la de nyid nas shing shal 0)ma li'i tshal 'byung bar 'gyur te / de la de nyid du ral gri dang / mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang /rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / mdung kha leb rnams rlung gis spags53)te de'i steng du 'bab bo/ /de ste rtsig pa'i gseb bam 2)ri'i sul lam bya skyibs dag tu 'gro bar 'dod na yang de la de 9nyid nas las las skyes pa'i mi dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ ral gri dang / mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / mdung kha leb rnams thogs nas de'i lus la 'debs te /de dag gis de'i lusamatsho/1thams cad bcad77cing gtub par byed de/ rgyu des na sdug bsngal drag pa dang / mi bzad 12pa dang / tsha ba dang / yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba myong ste nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin cingam ngu'o/ /de nas de'i ku co'i skasgras mnyan du yod pa thams cad gang bar gyur to/ /mnyan du yod pa'i skye bo 73—143

phal po ches 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra de lta bu thos so/ /thos nas kyang sems can stong phrag du ma mnyan du yod pa nas byung ste/ sgra grags3)pa'i logs su chu klung khang 5ldan ga la ba der dong nas skye bo phal po che 5)de dag gis/ thag ring po zhig nas lasems can de de lta bu'i gnod pa'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de dag gis bsams pa/ sems can 'di lta bum5)gnod pa'i sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ba nyams su myong ba 'di su zhig snyam mo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs shing gzhes ri ril 'tsho ba rnams ni chos nyid kyis dus dus su/ gtsug lag khang dang / dur khrod dang / ri dang chu klung dag tu rgyu zhing gshegs te don 'di'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das chu klung du rgyu zhing gshegs par bzhed nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo song la dge slong rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa ni chu klung du rgyu zhing gshegs kyis 8su de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cig 49)tu rgyu zhing 'gro 'dod pa de dag chos gos khodag chos shig ces bsgo /1shig /de skad ces bka' stsal te bsgo 2nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi tshogs kyis zhabs 'bring byas te 1 dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun 'du bdar nas chu klung khang ldan ga la ba der gshegs so/ /de nas skye bo'i tshogs kyis thag ring po nas bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang ma dad pa gang yin pa de dag na re dge sbyong go ta ma ltad mo la dga' ba med do zhes grag tshan de yang ltad mo'i dbang du gyur te 'ongs so zhes zer ro/ /dad pa dang ldan pa gang yin pa de dag na re tshabacom ldan 'das sems can 'di las ’ brten te ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos cig 8lung ston par bzhed gor ma chag ces zer nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 73wa 144

gdan bshams te smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das tshur gshegs/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa legs so legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa la bzhugs su gsol zhes zer ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa la bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs ti)pa/ ma la bdag sems can 'di ci nas sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran la mi'i skad du smra zhing bdag dang 5gtam zer bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o snyam du dgongs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ci nas sems can des sngon gyi tshe rabs dran la mi'i skad du smra zhing / bcom ldan 'das dang gtam zer bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ der bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can de ril bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzangasam khyod sgam po yin nam/ bcom ldan 'das bdag sgam po lags so/ /bzhin bzangs 5khyod sgam po yin nam/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag sgam po lags so/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi nyes par spyod pa'i las rnams kyi 'bras bu myong ba phyiyod dam/bcom ldan 'das myong ba mchis lags so/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi nyes par spyod pa'i las rnams kyi 'bras bu mi sdug pa yin nam/ bde bar gshegs pa 7)mi sdug pa lags so/ /khyod kyi mi dge ba'i bshegasams gnyen su yin/ des gsol pa/ rang gi sems lags so/ /de nas skye bo phal po che de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di lta bu'i sems can sngon gyi tshe rabs dran la mi'i skad du smra zhing bcom ldan 'das dang gtam zer ba 'di su zhig snyam mo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni snyan slebs 9par dka' ste/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi snyan du zhu ma 7nus nas de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 73—145

la dris pa/ btsun pa kunatudaga' bo 'di lta bu'i sems can sngon gyi tshe rabs dran la mi'i skad du smra zhing / bcom ldan 'das dang gtam zer ba 'di su zhig/tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus shig /de dag gis smras pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni snyan slebasalgepar dka' zhing gzi byin bzod par dka'ar bas bdag cag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi snyan du zhu mi nus so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos smras pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bdag gis kyang snyan slebs gepar dka' mod kyi/ 'on kyang khyed la snying brtse ra ba'i phyir zhu bar bgyi'o zhes smras nas/tshe dang ldan pa kun 6)dga' bos bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 7)logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 'di lta bu'i sems can sngon gyi tshe rabs dran la mi'i 8skad du smra zhing / bcom ldan 'das la bka' mchid gsol pa 'di su zhig lags/ der bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo sems can 'di ni sdig pa'i las byed byed pa yin te/ 'dis sdig pa'i las mang du byas so/ /kun dga' bo sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'das pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen7pa/ skyes bu gdulatswabya'i kha lo sgyur ba / bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od zer can/ zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung77ste/ de'i tshe dgra bcom 73—146

pa zhig dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang thabs ciganyetu ljongs rgyu zhing song ba las rgyal po'i pho brang zhig tu phyin nas/ de dag rgyal po de'i skyed mos tshal du song ste/rganasarims bzhin du shing drung re rer rtswa btingarwaminas skyil mo krung stobacas te bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byeda')do/ /de nas de'i tshe rgyal po'i pho brang7de nyid na rgyal po sgam po zhes bya ba rgyal po byed de/ rgyal po de nang par sngar langs nas bud med kyi 'khor gyis zhabs 'bringar byas te skyedams)mos tshal der song7ngo / /de der song nas phyogs gcigs7tu 'dug pa dang / bud med de dag me tog dang 'bras bu la srid pas phan tshun du 'khyam zhing /nyadong ba las bud med de dag gis dge slong lnga brgya po de dag shing drung dag na klu'i rgyal po ltar lus bskyil te gnyid log pa bzhin du skyil mo krung7bcas te 'khod pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang mchog tu dga' ba skyes so/ /de dag dga' ba skyes nas de dag gis mazhabs la 7phyag 'tshal te/ de dag gi nang na ches rgan pa gang yin pa de'i mdun du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'khod do/ /de nas brgyal po des skyed mos tshal de'i nang nas skyes pa'i sgra thos so/ /thos nas kyang ral gri rnon po mgul 7du thogs te/ dge slong de dag ga la ba der song nas rgyal po des dge slong lnga brgya /rnyede dag thag ring po nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dge slong rnams kyis nga'i btsun mo'i 'khor mthong gis med do snyam ste/ khro ba'i kun nas dkris hu)pa chen po skyes nas mthong ma thag tu rgyal po des rgyal po'i zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la bos te/ de dag la bsgo ba/ dge slong 'di rnams lcag gis gzhus zhu tshoshig ces byas so/ /de nas re zhig na de dag lcag gis bzhus nas 73—147

dge slong de dag gi lus ril gyis71)zhu lub tu sha snag bu bzhin du gyur to/ /de nas des dge slong de rnams snying tshim par bzhus nas gshed ma rnams la gtad den ske/ khyed deng la rab tu byung ba 'di rnams las kha cig ni gson55)por gsal shing la tshugs la ral gri dang / mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / mdung kha leb rnams kyis bsnunam /cig /kha cig55)ni gson por 6)khyi rnams la byin cig /kha cig ni lus dum bu drug tu chod la phyogs kun du bor zhig ces byas so/ /de nas rgyal po'i mi de dag gis de bzhin du 'tshal lo zhes byas nas/ dge slong lnga brgya 7)po de dag kha cig ni gson por gsal shing la btsugs sunas ral gri dang / mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang ske/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / mdung kha leb rnams kyis bsnun to/ /kha cig ni gson por khyi rnams la byin no/ /kha cig ni lus dum bu drug tu bcad de phyogs kun du bor ro/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe rgyal por gyur pa gang yin pa de ni sems can 'di nyid yin te/ des der dgra (9 bcom pa lnga brgya po de dag bsad pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par skyes so/ /des dge slong de dag la sdang ba'i sems kyis bltas pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas ni dmus long du gyur to/ /des dge slong de dag lcag gis gzhusamatshapa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas ni lus ril gyis rmas zhu lub tu yog par gyur to/ /spyi bo man chad rkang mthil 31yan chad du srin zhugs so/ /des 12de dag gshed ma la gtad de kha cig ni gson por gsal shing la btsugs nas ral gri dang / mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang /rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / mdung kha leb rnams kyis bsnun pa dang / kha cig ni 73—148

gson por0)khyi rnams la byin pa dang / kha cig ni gson por lus dum bu drug tu bcad de phyogs kun du gtor ba'i las de'i rnam par smin pas ni/ gal te thang la 'gro na ni de la de nyid nas seng ge dang / stag dang / gzig dang /dred la sogs pa lcags kyi mche ba can dgas 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag gis de'i sha rnams bcad cing bcad cing za'o/ /de ste chum 'bog na ni de la de nyid las 'chu srin ma ka ra lcags kyi /rimache ba can dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/de dag gis kyang de'i sha rnams bcad cing bcad cing za'o/ /de 6)steng gi nam mkha' la 'gro na ni de la de nyid nas bya rog dang / bya rgod dang / chun lag lcags kyi mchu can dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag gis kyang de'i sha rnams bcad cing bcad cing za'o/ /de ste7rinags stugs nipo'i nang du 'gro na ni/ de la de nyid nas shing shal ma li'i tshal 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de la de nyid du ral gri dang / mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang /mdung kha leb rnams rlung gis spags 9)te de'i steng du 'bab bo/ /de ste rtsig pa'i gseb bam ri'i sul lam bya skyibs dag tu 'gro bar 'dod na yang de la de nyid nas las las skyes pa'i mi dag 'byung bar 'gyur te ral gri dang / mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / mdung kha leb rnams thogs nas de'i lus la 'debs te/ de dag gis de'i lus thams cad bcad cing gtub par 7byed de rgyu des na des sdug bsngal drag pa 11dang mi bzad pa dang / tsha ba dang yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba myong ste nyam thag pa'i skad 'byin cing ngu'o/ /dge slong dag yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer can gyi ring mtshun chad nas/ da ltar nga'i ring 1 gi bar du sems can 73—149
